description_en: Adds a video source to a production studio. The number of video sources is limited by the number of input channels of the production studio
description_zh: 添加视频源，视频源数量受限于导播台输入路数
kebab_example: aliyun live add-caster-video-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --resource-name test001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCasterVideoResource

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the CasterId parameter value returned by the CreateCaster operation.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, navigate to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studios > Cloud Production Studio to view the production studio name.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page of the ApsaraVideo Live console is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the video source
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en:
The location identifier of the video source. This parameter is required. 

Defines the reference number of a scene in the layout. Each location can be associated with at most one resource. The format must match "RV01~RV12", which is RV + a number in the range of `[01~99]`
parameters.help_zh:
用于标识视频源位置。本参数必填。 

定义布局内画面的引用编号，每个位置至多关联一个资源，格式需符合“RV01~RV12”，即RV+数字，数字范围`[01~99]`
parameters.name: location_id

parameters.help_en:
The ApsaraVideo Live streaming URL.

<notice> 
 
This parameter is required when the video source type is live stream.
 
Do not include this parameter in the request when the video source type is not live stream.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云直播流地址。

<notice> 
 
当视频源类型为直播流时，本参数必填。
 
视频源类型不是直播流时，请求时不要带这个参数。

</notice>
parameters.name: live_stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The media asset library material ID.
<notice>This parameter is available and required only when the video source type is material.
</notice>

If you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848011.html operation to query the production studio configuration, check the UrgentMaterialId parameter value returned by the DescribeCasterConfig operation.

The UrgentMaterialId value is the media asset library material ID
parameters.help_zh:
媒资库素材ID。
<notice>当视频源类型为素材时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
</notice>

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848011.html查询导播台配置信息，请查看DescribeCasterConfig接口调用返回的参数UrgentMaterialId值。

UrgentMaterialId值即为媒资库素材ID值
parameters.name: material_id

parameters.help_en:
The video-on-demand file URL.
<notice>This parameter is available only when the video source type is file video and the video file has not been imported to the media asset library.
</notice>

Video-on-demand files are limited to MP4, FLV, and TS formats
parameters.help_zh:
点播文件地址。
<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频且视频文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。
</notice>

点播文件仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式
parameters.name: vod_url

parameters.help_en:
The start offset of the video file. Unit: milliseconds.
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when the video source type is file video.
</notice>

A value greater than 0 indicates that reading starts from the offset time relative to the first frame
parameters.help_zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。单位：毫秒。
<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
</notice>

大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置
parameters.name: begin_offset

parameters.help_en:
The end offset of the video file. Unit: milliseconds.
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when the video source type is file video.
</notice>
        
A value greater than 0: reading ends at the offset time relative to the first frame.
A value less than 0: reading ends at the offset time relative to the last frame
parameters.help_zh:
视频文件结束偏移值。单位：毫秒。
<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
</notice>
        
大于0时：从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
小于0时：相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置。
parameters.name: end_offset

parameters.help_en:
The number of times the video repeats after playback completes. Valid values:
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when the video source type is file video.
</notice>

0 (default): no repeat.
-1: loops indefinitely
parameters.help_zh:
播放完后重复继续播放的次数。取值：
<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
</notice>

0（默认值）：不重复播放。
-1：一直循环重复
parameters.name: repeat_num

parameters.help_en: The PTS callback interval. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.name: pts_callback_interval

parameters.help_en: The fixed delay for the video, which can be used for subtitle synchronization. Unit: ms. Default value: 0. Value range: `[0-5000]`
parameters.help_zh: 该字段对视频进行固定延迟设置，可用于字幕同步。单位ms, 默认取值为0， 取值范围`[0-5000]`
parameters.name: fixed_delay_duration

parameters.help_en:
The media asset library image material ID.
This parameter is available and required only when the video source type is image
parameters.help_zh:
媒资库图片素材ID。
当视频源类型为图片时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The image material URL.
This parameter is available only when the video source type is image and the image file has not been imported to the media asset library. JPG and PNG formats are supported. The maximum file size is 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
图片素材URL。
当视频源类型为图片且图片文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。支持上传jpg、png格式图片，最大文件不可超过10M
parameters.name: image_url

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID. This ID can be used as a request parameter for deleting or modifying a video source in the production studio
ResourceId.description_zh: 资源ID。可作为删除导播台视频源，修改导播台视频源的请求参数
